statement: On 160 grid tasks (seed grid/velocity) and 6175 components, the evaluation matrix scored the same 60 genomes at 4,292,190 evals/s against 19.248 evals/s for real grid cells ticked in a Brain, a ratio of 222,993x against an aim of 100x (met); the two paths disagreed on 0 task outcomes, claims, counts or fitnesses across those genomes, and the full audit was skipped. On a synthetic landscape whose optimum is known, the ruler at patience 200 reported the generation the optimum was first held with a max error of 0 generations (tolerance 0) and ended holding the planted set on 4 of 4 fresh seeds with the directed engine (directed 0.75, optimum first held at generation 35..116), while the undirected engine on the same seeds did so on 4 (generation 162..387) and stopped early on 0; at patience 20 the directed engine was on time on 3 and stopped early on 1. Infinite mode fired on 2 of 2 planes of a finite list and ran 79 planes of an unbounded list until its 2000 ms budget ended (stop: wall), carrying a best of 158/160 (union bound 159); the best library solved 111/160 of a fresh draw. The organism-years printed are declared arithmetic, never a measurement, and all wall numbers were taken on a machine shared with other processes. Bar met.

years.arithmetic: 123937 evaluations x 2025.867 ticks each (measured on the tick path) x 0.001 s/tick (declared) / 31557600 s/year = 7.956240e-3 organism-years (declared arithmetic, not a measurement)
